title: 3-Day Southwest National Parks Private Tour from Las Vegas
includes: This tour has a free downloadable App with tour commentary in French, German, Spanish and Italian.
Camping accommodations (if option selected; tent with mat)
Use of sleeping bags and camping equipment (if camping option selected)
National park entry fees (excludes additional non US resident government fees if applicable)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children under 17 years must be accompanied by an adult
This is a fully private tour for just your group
You may experience both warm and cool temperatures. It is recommended that you pack warm socks, a sweater or hooded jacket, hiking shoes, plenty of sunscreen, closed-toe shoes and a hat
Please note: bottled water is not provided on this tour. It is advised that you to bring a refillable container. You will be able to refill at comfort stops made throughout your trip.
Please note that sunrise viewings in Monument Valley may not be available when booking the lodging option due to availability of certain accommodations
Vegetarian meals are available upon request
Campsites (if selected) are typically equipped with Wi-Fi, laundry and hot showers, and some may have outdoor hot tubs and swimming pools
Child lodging accommodations: children will be in a room with the adults in their party. There is up to a four person maximum per room with two queen beds

Lodging accommodation is a 2-person room shared by same-sex travelers or on a couple basis. If your party is 3 or 5 guests, you will be in 1 or 2 triples rooms with two queen beds in each. All lodging accommodations are of 3 star quality or higher
cancellation:
If you cancel at least 14 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel within 14 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb:
Visit three National Parks of the American Southwest on this 3-day seasonal adventure from Las Vegas, with the option of comfortable lodging. See Zion National Park, Bryce Canyon and the Grand Canyon, where an optional helicopter ride takes you over the South Rim plus explore Monument Valley on a Navajo-guided Jeep tour. 
This is a fully private tour with an expert guide throughout, with selected ticket type. Option to camp or stay in hotels.

Tour Highlights

Camp under starry skies with camping ticket type
Retire to a cozy hotel room in prime locations with hotel ticket type
Spectacular national parks walks & hikes for every fitness level
Grand Canyon sunset
Expert tour guide throughout with entertaining stories, history, flora and fauna who knows the best locations for optimal exploration of the parks
Navajo guided Monument Valley 4X4 jeep tour included
Spectacular photography inside of Antelope Canyon (if option selected)
Leisurely stroll along the Grand Canyon South Rim
